We discovered a box that had double allocations
cache may be to blame.  While auditing the write out path I noticed that
if we've already setup the space cache we will just carry on.  This
means that any error we hit after cache_save_setup before we go to
actually write the cache out we won't reset the inode generation
whatever was already written will be considered correct
stale.  Fix this by _always_ resetting the generation on the block group

column2: this way we only ever have valid or invalid cache.

column1: With this patch I was no longer able to reproduce cache corruption with
dm-log-writes and my bpf error injection tool.
